modules.title: ERP Suite Overview
modules.html:
Enterprise ERP Suite

Our custom-built ERP is tailored to your enterprise needs. A unified platform that connects CRM, operations, billing, and HR—replacing siloed tools with one cohesive system.

What's Included

  • CRM & Complaints – Lead tracking, customer history, ticket management
  • AMC Services – Annual maintenance contracts, renewals, service schedules
  • Automated Billing & Accounts – Invoicing, ledger sync, payment reminders
  • Tool Management – Equipment tracking, allocation, maintenance logs
  • Employee & Login Control – Role-based access, audit trails
  • Attendance & Payroll – Biometric integration, leave, salary processing

Built to scale with your business. No generic templates—every workflow is designed around your processes.

modules.title: CRM & Complaints
modules.html:
CRM & Complaints Management

Centralize customer interactions, track leads through the pipeline, and resolve complaints with structured workflows and escalation rules.

Key Features

  • 360° customer view with history and notes
  • Complaint tickets with SLA tracking and auto-assignment
  • Lead scoring and follow-up reminders
  • Email and activity logging

modules.title: Billing & Accounts Integration
modules.html:
Automated Billing & Accounts Integration

Connect billing to your accounting system. Generate invoices, sync ledgers, and automate payment reminders—reducing manual data entry and reconciliation errors.

Capabilities

  • Recurring invoices and AMC renewals
  • Integration with Tally, QuickBooks, and custom ERP
  • Payment tracking and reconciliation
  • Automated reminders and statements

modules.title: HR, Attendance & Payroll
modules.html:
Employee Control, Attendance & Payroll

Manage employees, enforce login policies, track attendance, and process payroll—all within the same system that handles your operations.

Features

  • Employee & Login Control – Role-based access, device limits, session management
  • Attendance – Biometric, QR, or app-based check-in/out
  • Payroll – Salary calculation, PF/ESI, payslips, bank transfers
  • Tool Management – Assign equipment, track usage, maintenance schedules

modules.title: Blog & Document Management
modules.html:
Blog & Document Management

Create, publish, and organize content—blogs, knowledge bases, and internal documents—with versioning, search, and access control.

Features

  • Rich-text editor with media support
  • Categories, tags, and search
  • Draft, review, and publish workflows
  • Document storage with folders and permissions
  • Version history and audit trails

modules.title: Property Management System
modules.html:
Proptech – Property Management System

End-to-end property management: visitor flows, security, approvals, communication, facility ops, and billing—all in one platform.

Core Capabilities

  • Visitor Management – Pre-registration, check-in, badges
  • Security Workflows – Patrols, incidents, access logs
  • Approvals – Maintenance requests, gate passes, NOCs
  • Communication – Resident notices, bulk SMS/email
  • Staff Coordination – Task assignment, shift scheduling
  • Facility Operations – Amenities booking, maintenance tracking
  • Billing & Maintenance – Society charges, due reminders
  • AI Automation – Optional smart suggestions and automation

modules.title: Visitor & Security
modules.html:
Visitor & Security Management

Streamline visitor entry with pre-registration, QR codes, and real-time check-in. Log security rounds, incidents, and access for audit and compliance.

What You Get

  • Visitor pre-registration and OTP/QR entry
  • Security patrol tracking and incident reports
  • Access control logs and reports
  • Integration with existing gate systems

modules.title: Operations, Billing & AI
modules.html:
Operations, Billing & AI Automation

Run facility ops smoothly—maintenance requests, approvals, staff tasks—and automate billing, reminders, and reporting. Optional AI boosts efficiency with smart insights.

Features

  • Maintenance request and approval flows
  • Society billing, maintenance charges, due reminders
  • Staff task allocation and coordination
  • AI-driven automation for common workflows

modules.title: Database Query Agents
modules.html:
Database Query Agents

AI agents that query your data directly—ask questions in plain language and get answers from your data-lake or databases. No SQL needed, with governed access and audit logs.

How It Works

  • Connect to your data sources (DB, data-lake, APIs)
  • Ask questions in natural language
  • Agents generate queries, run them safely, and return results
  • Role-based access and query logging

modules.title: Tele-calling Bots & Outreach
modules.html:
Tele-calling Bots & Automated Outreach

AI bots that call customers from batch files, follow scripts, and handle responses. Combined with WhatsApp and email automation—a full outreach package that drives scheduled meetings.

What's Included

  • Tele-calling Bots – Batch file upload, auto-dial, scripted conversations
  • WhatsApp Automation – Templates, triggers, follow-ups
  • Email Automation – Drip campaigns, sequences
  • Meeting Scheduling – Calendars, reminders, confirmations

modules.title: Call Recording Analysis
modules.html:
Call Recording Analysis

Turn call recordings into actionable insights: improve pitch, spot training needs, catch anomalies, and flag bad customer behavior—all with AI-driven analysis.

Use Cases

  • Sales Conversion – What works in winning pitches
  • Tele-caller Coaching – Gaps in script, tone, objection handling
  • Anomaly Detection – Unusual patterns, compliance risks
  • Customer Behavior – Track abuse, escalation triggers
